correctness.rationale: Read actual RESULT.md and verify.py. At positive levels the countable Markov depth chain holds with probability 1-q and descends with q; level zero regenerates geometric depth 2^{-j-1}. Direct stationary balance gives pi_0=q/(1+q) and pi_k=2^{-k}/(1+q). The signed-row identities wP=sw+dv* and v*P=rv*, including level-zero boundaries, rigorously give C_n=2(1-q/2)^n+2q(1-q)/(1+q)^2*((1-q)/2)^n. Summing lags yields exact finite variance and Green-Kubo coefficient. A polynomial Poisson solution and martingale CLT establish fixed-q CLT; a uniform-grid/Riemann-sum argument establishes the triangular Nq_N->t crossover. Independently recomputed finite-state transition covariance at q=2/5 for lags 0,1,2,3,5,10 with numerical errors under 1e-9; this is corroboration, not proof of infinite chain or CLT.
residual_risks: Technical martingale CLT requires stationary ergodicity and square-integrability of Poisson h; both supplied by irreducibility, aperiodicity and geometric pi tail.
At q=0 irreducibility fails; only limit from q>0 asserted.
